mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and volume depletion potentiate clonidine's hypotensive and CNS effects, while abrupt clonidine withdrawal may cause rebound hypertension in the setting of diuretic use.
action: Monitor blood pressure, serum potassium, and fluid status closely; ensure adequate potassium supplementation if needed; counsel patient on importance of medication adherence to avoid clonidine rebound hypertension.
